title: English story titles in the Spanish home page ticker
what_happened: On the Spanish page the story strip under the hero shows "How We're Born", "July 2026 Bulletin", "Where We're Born" in English, next to the Spanish label "Leer la historia". The logo tagline is also English.
expected: Story titles in Spanish on the Spanish page, or at least not mixed into a Spanish sentence line.

title: Hero says plainly what and where, in Spanish
what_happened: The site opened in Spanish on its own and the first sentence says health, housing, youth development and cultural connections in Nicaragua, Dominican Republic and the US. Cookie banner had a clear "Rechazar todo".

title: "Ser voluntario" promised but no volunteer option on Involúcrate
what_happened: The intro on Involúcrate says "donar, ser voluntario, asociarte o abogar", but the cards are only Viajar, Donar, Asociarse and Compartir Historias. There's no volunteer card for someone like me who saw volunteers painting a classroom. The page also leans on "impacto" and "agentes de cambio" without concrete examples.
expected: A volunteer card (or a line saying volunteering happens through the trips), with one concrete example like painting a school.
